pos.personaBrief: No verified tactical evidence; from general knowledge Cardoso is a Portuguese coach of possession-based, proactive teams (Espérance, Sundowns league and CAF success with dominant sides).

pro.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: patient, short build-up from the back typical of his Portuguese school, direct ball only when the opening is clear.

est.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: structured, positional organisation with defined roles in each phase.

lar.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: balanced use of width with wide players stretching play but combinations through the half-spaces.

blo.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: proactive teams that press and counter-press high and defend far from their box.

mar.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: zonal, space-oriented defending typical of Portuguese schooled coaches.

pla.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: strong own game model that the team keeps against most opponents, with little adaptation.

res.personaBrief: Verified only that he won the Tunisian league and CAF Champions League; otherwise general knowledge: ambitious, winning-minded but proactive in style.

sis.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: collective system and tactical roles come first, with duties for all.

jog.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: technical players suited to possession play, with intensity required but not physical dominance.

bas.personaBrief: No verified evidence; titles won with experienced, signed squads at Espérance and Sundowns, not academy-based.

lid.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: a communicative, people-oriented coach who still applies common rules.
